newsitem.title: USA: Superior Supplements FY 97 sales results.
newsitem.headline: Superior Supplements FY 97 sales results.

text.p: Superior Supplements Inc said its net sales for the fiscal year ended June 30 were $4,638,129.
The company also reported net sales for its fourth quarter of $2,031,518.
The company said its sales have increased due to an increase in its production capacity from the completion of a manufacturing facility.
The company, however, was not immediately available to discuss its comparable fourth quarter or fiscal 1997 results.
Superior Supplements develops, manufactures and markets dietary supplements including vitamins, minerals, herb and specialty nutritional supplements.
